description: This file defines the 'Edit' feature for user profile updates in an ASP.NET Core application. It includes a data model for user input, validation logic, and a request handler that updates user information in the database and returns the updated user data envelope.

classes.name: Edit.UserData
classes.description: Data transfer object for user profile data fields such as username, email, password, bio, and image.

classes.name: Edit.Command
classes.description: Request object representing an update to a user profile, containing the user data.

classes.name: Edit.CommandValidator
classes.description: Validation class ensuring the command contains non-null user data.

classes.name: Edit.Handler
classes.description: Handles the update request, applies changes to the user entity in the database, and returns the updated user envelope.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Executes the user profile update logic: retrieves current user, applies changes, hashes password if provided, saves to database, and returns the updated user envelope.
